move: note glyph draws in white, cyan and red ghosts split on bass thumps, glitch slices tear
how: Three stacked copies of the TikTok note path (cyan, red, white; cyan and red in screen blend), two 30px-tall horizontal slice windows showing the white layer, a scanline overlay, a handle with cyan/red ghost copies, and a progress bar. 0-27%: all paths drawSVG 0->100% (power3.inOut) while the group scales .8->1 (expo.out); at 17% the handle rises in (expo.out); the bar scaleX 0->1 linearly over the full 3s. Thumps at 30%, 50%, 70%, 87%: the group scales 1.1 (0.08s) then elastic.out(1,.4) back; the cyan layer jumps -14..-32px up-left and the red the mirror amount (0.06s) then both snap to 0 with elastic.out(1,.35); the handle ghosts offset +-8px and ease back; one slice tears sideways 40-80px for 0.08s, returns and vanishes. At 88% the strokes erase to '100% 100%' (power3.in) and the handle slides up out, leaving the bar full.
adapt: Replace the note path with the product mark, the cyan/red (#25f4ee/#fe2c55) split colours, the handle string and the thump times. Keep the 0.8s draw, the 0.06s offset + elastic snap, and the 0.08s slice tear.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the three layers, slices, tag and bar inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with thumps at 0.3D, 0.5D, 0.7D, 0.87D and the erase at 0.88D. Register DrawSVGPlugin; scope '.layer', '.slice', '.tag', '.bar' to el; the slice --y offsets rely on the 480px-tall wrap, so keep the same proportions. The tag span from() needs immediateRender:false when nested.
caveats: mix-blend-mode: screen on two layers and the tag ghosts
progress bar ends full and strokes end erased, so no clean loop
the last thump at 2.6s overlaps the erase at 2.65s
